title: Frequency bad set
statement: For a natural number $n$, real number $\varepsilon$, and binary vector $\gamma$ of length $n$, the frequency bad set consists of sample sequences for which $\gamma$ is nonzero and the absolute empirical mean of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ is at least $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the empirical mean or Walsh character, so their conventional meanings are assumed.
